aggregate_roots.description: At least one candidate aggregate root, named at Strategic Design (07-stages.md Stage 2 gate). Full invariants follow in Tactical Design (Stage 5).

owning_team.description: Extension beyond the base spec pack: the team that owns this Context end to end, named at Stage 2 adjudication from intake.json's teams[] roster. Team Topology is ddd-reference.md §4 rule 5 -- a tiebreaker heuristic, never a primary boundary criterion -- but once a boundary is decided on other grounds, recording who owns it is what makes the boundary actionable and is what Waypoint records reference.
